serverInfo.name: telenow
serverInfo.title: Telenow — AI Phone Calls & Voice Agents

description: Place phone calls, run calling campaigns and build voice agents from your own Telenow numbers.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers the assistant may call from. The first is the default caller ID.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place one real phone call with the built-in calling agent or one of your agents. Returns a call_id at once.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get one call by call_id: status, outcome, summary and transcript.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent inbound and outbound calls on the assistant's numbers, newest first.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the organization's voice agents, most recently changed first.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent's full configuration, with keys masked.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a single-context voice agent from a name and system prompt.

tools.name: create_flow_agent
tools.description: Create a multi-step voice agent defined as a graph of nodes and edges.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Change an agent this assistant created.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List voices an agent can use, each with an audio sample.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost per minute in USD for an existing or planned agent.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List calling campaigns on the assistant's numbers, newest first.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign and its per-person results.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a calling campaign as a draft. Nothing is dialed.

tools.name: add_campaign_targets
tools.description: Add up to 1,000 people to a campaign this assistant created.

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start or resume a campaign this assistant created.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a campaign. No new people are dialed; calls in progress finish.
